svg.text: Front panel, top view · 560 × 300 mm · 8 group faders + master · wifi → hub :8765 · every part is reassignable in software
Main display — 2.42" OLED: track, BPM, mode, bank (read from hub /state)
Status LEDs — wifi, hub link, clock-sync, recording
Art mode switch — deterministic / paint / AI (sets hub mode)
Who drives — AUTO = hub paints album art; BOARD = you do (pauses auto-paint)
Hue + saturation encoders (push = reset) — act on the last-touched channel
Palette keys — RGB backlit; tap = apply, hold = store current color
Fader function — faders control level, hue or saturation
Banks A/B/C — 3 × 8 = 24 groups across LIFX, WLED strips and Playbill nodes
Scribble strips — tiny OLEDs showing each channel's group name
ASSIGN — hold + tap a light/group in the GUI or press a cue to remap that fader
100 mm faders — smooth intensity, like a real desk
FLASH — momentary full-level bump while held (strobe fixtures use WLED, not LIFX)
BLACKOUT — all fixtures dark instantly, press again to restore
Cue buttons — recall a scene/look; shift+tap stores one
Transport — REC arms and records everything you move against the song position
Sync nudge encoder — trim recorded-light offset vs audio, in ms
Tap tempo — sets beat grid for chases when no audio tap is available
ELECTRONICS (one controller board behind the panel)
Power: 5 V USB-C (~1.5 A max with all backlights). Mains-powered, so no battery limits.
front panel sloped ~10° toward you · 30 mm front, 70 mm rear
Face plate: 3 mm aluminum or acrylic, laser-cut/CNC. Case: plywood, or printed in sections (560 mm exceeds most beds).
Rear: USB-C power · reset/boot · spare Ethernet-to-wifi bridge option
